title: Partition to k equal-sum subsets
statement: Return whether the array (n ≤ 16) can be divided into k non-empty subsets with equal sums.
hints: Fill buckets one at a time; the only thing that matters is which numbers are used.
dp[mask] = fill of the current bucket after using mask (or −1 if unreachable).

solution.explanation: The bucket contents don't matter, only which elements are used and how full the current bucket is, and the latter is determined by the sum of the mask modulo t. So dp[mask] = (sum of mask) mod t if reachable. Fill buckets in order, never exceeding t. Backtracking with sorting and pruning also passes; the DP has a clean worst case.
